prompt: A wide, very dark, atmospheric background painting for the title screen of a mythology card game: a vast night sea under stars, with faint distant silhouettes along the horizon from three mythologies: a Greek temple on a cliff at the left, a Norse longhall beneath the great world tree in the middle distance, Chinese mountain peaks and a pagoda among clouds at the right. Low contrast and dark overall, most of the detail near the edges and bottom, the centre calm and empty so a title and buttons can sit on top. Rustic 1990s hand-painted style, gouache, matte. No text, no letters, no people in the foreground.
